title: How to stop Claude Lying or Hallucinating!
description:
Claude can often lie or hallucinate, but using the Claude Council of 5 Skill will stop it from lying.

This will improve your AI Claude outputs.

Comment "Council" and I'll send it over to you.

Thanks to @aiwithremy for finding this one 🙌
